question: Do independent locality, sampling, and mapped-wetland sources establish that the Tambo Lake / Lake Tambo lead in Sta. Juliana, Capas is the same lake and provide a publishable boundary?

officialLocality.supports: Municipal charter explicitly lists Tambo Lake under Capas tourist destinations and associates the listing with Barangay Sta. Juliana.
doesNotSupport: exact shoreline or legal waterbody boundary
current access, safety, or fishing rules

publishedSamplingSite.biologicalScope: Freshwater microcrustacean zooplankton sampling sites; not fish sampling.
publishedSamplingSite.supports: A published historical sampling-locality lead near the Capas charter locality. The spelling order differs from PNA and Capas charter but exact waterbody identity is not formally crosswalked.
doesNotSupport: assigning every taxon in the nationwide checklist to this site
precise positional accuracy or lake boundary

historicalWetlandArea.sourceReuseStatement: Educational or non-profit reproduction with acknowledgement per BMB copyright notice; Bangwit public-app reuse remains unapproved.
historicalWetlandArea.crosswalkDisposition: Regional name and approximate area context only; no municipality is reported in this row, so identity with the Capas/Sta. Juliana lake is not independently proven.

denrBasinPlanCorroboration.attribution: Table cites BMB (2014), Atlas of Inland Wetlands in Mainland Luzon.
denrBasinPlanCorroboration.interpretation: Rounded secondary restatement of historical regional area context; not an independent survey or boundary.

osmCandidateOutline.areaMethod: Spherical polygon area using Earth radius 6,371,008.8 m and the closed-ring longitude/sine-latitude summation formula; derived estimate, not a surveyed area.

paperCoordinateRelation.distanceMethod: Local equirectangular approximation at latitude 15.2917; rounded to nearest metre.

osmCandidateOutline.license: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL); attribution to OpenStreetMap contributors and ODbL notice required.
osmCandidateOutline.interpretation: Community-mapped outline candidate only. The near-edge point and approximate areas (79.37 ha versus atlas 91.98 ha) do not settle waterbody identity or true extent.

synthesis.namesAsReported: PNA and Capas use “Tambo Lake”; the microcrustacean paper and OSM use “Lake Tambo” / “Tambo Lake”. Shared Capas/Tarlac locality context supports investigating a name-variant relationship, but no formal exact-identity crosswalk was established.
synthesis.geometry: No authoritative or field-verified boundary was found. Do not promote the OSM candidate to app geometry; the coordinate offset and area difference remain unresolved and the OSM source is community mapped.
synthesis.fishEvidence: No fish taxon-resolved survey, fish occurrence, or catch record for this lake was added by this review. The paper concerns microcrustacean zooplankton; taxa in its aggregate nationwide checklist are not site observations absent explicit site linkage.
synthesis.sanMarcosLake: No new locality, survey, or geometry evidence for San Marcos Lake was found; retain the prior PNA stocking-only lead unchanged.

nextActions: Seek recent and historical taxon-resolved fish surveys or specimen vouchers explicitly tied to Tambo Lake/Sta. Juliana; do not treat stocking or microcrustacean records as fish evidence.
Seek a municipality-specific, datum-documented wetland boundary or independent field/geospatial survey before selecting geometry; keep the OSM candidate out of app data.
Keep Tambo and San Marcos Lake fish baselines, Central Luzon, and Luzon incomplete.

sources.supports: The prior review records a 2020 Capas stocking event under the “Tambo Lake” spelling; this is management context only and does not establish the exact Lake Tambo identity or fish presence.
Capas municipal charter page 118 names Tambo Lake and associates it with Barangay Sta. Juliana.
Methods and Table 1 site 25 identify a 2008–2015 microcrustacean sampling-locality frame and list Lake Tambo, Santa Juliana, Tarlac, with coordinates; it is not fish evidence.
BMB Atlas Table 1 row 60 lists Tambo Lake as a Region III lake with approximate area 91.98 ha; no municipality or boundary.
DENR-hosted report Table 70 repeats the BMB-derived Tambo Lake approximate area as 92.0 ha for Region 3.
OSM community-mapped version 3 outline metadata and ring used only to calculate candidate bbox/area/proximity; no app geometry.
